selection.selection_basis: Follow-up development selection after the first prototype failed a broader output audit. Spatial verifier v4, crop gate 0.9, path evidence floor 0.15, and elongated-color rejection retain 17/18 diagnostic positive samples and repeat none of nine diagnosed errors; old development frame check 13/16 correct with zero wrong outputs. Same known-positive recall as less conservative gate 0.8 with fewer weak outputs. These diagnostics are reused for selection; they are not a final independent test. The nine-point temporal check is now reused, and 23 current-game development positives train the verifier. The 59 cross-game regression labels remain out of training and were not scored for verifier selection. A subsequent 36-point additional-position audit exposed two more shoes and a held-ball projection error. This motivated a separately recorded GPT-6 Astra review stage. Its conservative application rule was specified in vlm-protocol.json and clarified in vlm-application.json; review decisions do not create coordinates.

recall.selection_basis: Additional visual candidates only, where the conservative CV pass was unknown. A diagnostic audit found red background lights accepted as airborne balls. Restrict this weaker recovery pass to reviewed floor support and valid floor projection; do not overwrite primary points or add interpolation. Fresh output audit follows this gate selection.

limitations: Existing detector weights trained on 92 visible NBHL frames; a separate crop verifier is newly trained on NBHL examples and hard negatives.
Sparse assistant-reviewed labels with approximate centers. Unknown visibility excluded, not a negative.

Eight current-game development positives and 15 development audit positives now train the verifier. Later audit errors informed model development. The nine-point temporal check is reused, not a new independent test.
Cross-game labels are existing regression sets from four recordings excluded from verifier weight training.
Coverage is output frequency, not accuracy. Wrong-object tracks remain possible.
Person filtering assumes a floor ball and may withhold a real ball near shoes, in a hand, or in flight.
Color-shape rejection targets this rink's red lines and elongated stick tape; it may withhold a ball on a marking or a severely blurred ball.
Error ellipses assume correct visual anchors and floor geometry. They are not calibrated probability guarantees.
Does not establish possession, shots, goals, assists, or metric ball speed.

OpenAI reviews at most five sampled positions per short candidate episode. Decisions extend to nearby frames, can be wrong, and are not ground truth. Missing/uncertain decisions withhold output. Non-floor support has no overhead position.

verifier_training.limits: Correlated pilot. Crop-verification validation is not full-frame detection accuracy. Hard negatives are mined only where a visible active ball has a known different location, plus 11 reviewed development false objects.

output_audit.sampling: Two strata: 24 quantiles of added primary-pass positions and all 24 recovery positions not previously used for its six-frame diagnostic. See output-audit-primary.json and output-audit-recall.json. Sampling is conditional on accepted outputs; strata are not weighted to estimate overall precision.
output_audit.limits: Assistant review, not independent human ground truth or fresh-game validation. Strong temporal correlation and nearby development examples; cannot estimate full-game precision or recall. No per-frame manual override was applied after this audit.
